purpose: Prior evidence check for 10 untried levers listed in Post-RC12 section (line 39027)

freeze_after_epoch_baseline.summary: freeze_after_epoch=10 is the standard recipe, freezing the ENTIRE MLP at epoch 10. Used in 99m_v2 and all subsequent experiments. Exp 120b_v8 showed that CRPS-only training with freeze still loses CI coverage (92.7%→87.7% by ep10) — freeze itself reduces coverage because only skip weights train post-freeze and CRPS compresses them.
freeze_after_epoch_baseline.key_finding: Freeze at ep10 is universally used. Confounded with IS activation in 120b_v8. Decoupled freeze (MLP early, skip never) proposed but never executed.

experiments_found: Lever B in post-RC12 table (1-step→5-step→30-step AR rollout)
levers.key_finding: Progressive rollout TRIED extensively in Exp 90–97b series. 60-frame rollout reliably destroyed conditionality (confirmed across 96c and 97b). 30-frame progressive rollout is safe and currently used. Curriculum NOISE (Gaussian→Student-t switch at ep10) tried in Exp 126a (5/8, kurtosis 0.739) — produced WORSE kurtosis than either endpoint. The specific lever 'B: AR rollout curriculum (1-step→5-step→30-step)' within the afCRPS+factor-noise architecture (146b base) is listed as untried in Post-RC12 table but closely related experiments exist. The AIFS-style staged rollout for multi-horizon calibration (longer rollouts for gradient signal at h>30) remains untried at the 146b base.
levers.verdict: PARTIALLY TRIED — progressive rollout tried at Exp 90–97b level (pre-factor-noise era). Curriculum noise tried as Exp 126a. The specific combination of (1→5→30-step rollout) ON THE 146b ARCHITECTURE has NOT been tried. Curriculum noise (distinct from rollout) is exhausted.
levers.note: Rollout curriculum on 146b base is a genuine untried variant. Curriculum noise Gaussian→Student-t is exhausted.

levers.match_count: K=16: 5 matches; K=32: 1 match (table only); n_members=16: 1 match (table only)
experiments_found: H1b in RC9 compass (K=16 proposed but superseded by RC10)
levers.key_finding: Exp 89h tested K=16 with the OLD architecture (pre-AR-frame, pre-factor-noise, pre-skip-bypass). Result: faster convergence but same CRPS equilibrium (CI 76.5% vs 77.6% for K=4). H1b (K=16 with 99m_v2 recipe) was PROPOSED in RC9 compass but was superseded before execution when user challenged spread_weight=0.65 as unprincipled. The Post-RC12 lever 'A: Larger K in training (K=8→16 or K=32)' on the 146b base has NEVER been run.
levers.verdict: TRIED IN OLD ARCHITECTURE (Exp 89h, pre-factor-noise). NOT tried on current 146b/factor-noise architecture. H1b was proposed but never executed.
levers.note: K=16 on the 146b+factor-noise architecture is genuinely untried. 89h result (same equilibrium) may not generalize because factor noise changes the collapse mechanism.

levers.match_count: biased CRPS: 3 matches; IS warmup: found Exp 120b_v8; warmup CRPS: 3 matches
experiments_found: biased CRPS referenced in RC10 compass and post-RC12 table as Lever F
levers.key_finding: IS warmup (CRPS-only then IS activation) tried as Exp 120b_v8 — result 4/8, confounded with freeze timing. This is DIFFERENT from biased CRPS warmup. Biased CRPS warmup (CRPS-LAM approach: large K + biased CRPS for first 10 epochs, then fair afCRPS) is LISTED in post-RC12 table as Lever F and has never been executed. References: CRPS-LAM (arxiv 2510.09484) and FourCastNet3 (2507.12144).
levers.verdict: IS warmup tried (Exp 120b_v8, confounded). True biased-to-fair CRPS warmup (large K + biased CRPS then switch to fair afCRPS) is GENUINELY UNTRIED.
levers.note: Lever F (biased CRPS warmup) is distinct from IS warmup and is genuinely untried on 146b base.

experiments_found: Lever G in post-RC12 table (freeze CLN, train skip)
levers.key_finding: Exp 132a_v2 tried freezing CLN at epoch 5 on the 4-layer CLN architecture (NOT the current factor-noise skip architecture). Result: kurtosis stuck at 0.067, eff_rank collapsed from 2.21→1.44 because skip/spread continued to rank-compress despite frozen CLN. The Post-RC12 Lever G ('After 10 epochs, freeze CLN weights, continue skip/factor training') is targeted at the 146b architecture where CLN and factor-noise skip coexist — this specific combination has NOT been tried.
levers.verdict: CLN freeze tried on 4-layer CLN architecture (132a_v2, failed). NOT tried on 146b+factor-noise architecture where CLN and skip interact differently.
levers.note: 132a_v2 failed for a different architectural reason (skip continued compressing rank). On 146b, CLN freeze after ep10 + continued factor-noise skip training is genuinely untried.

levers.match_count: noise_dim=64: 3 direct matches; noise_dim=128: 1 mention in post-RC12 table
levers.key_finding: noise_dim=64 tried twice: Exp 89r (old architecture, no improvement on kurtosis) and Exp 129a (current architecture: 5/8, score 66.08 vs baseline 66.31 — slight regression). Exp 129a analysis: wider noise makes MLP input even more noise-dominated (27% vs 16%), amplifying shared noise pathway and strengthening rank-1 attractor. noise_dim=128 is LISTED in post-RC12 table as Lever D but has NEVER been run.
levers.verdict: noise_dim=64 TRIED (Exp 129a, marginal regression). noise_dim=128 has never been tried.
levers.note: noise_dim=64 is exhausted (129a showed slight harm). noise_dim=128 is a new point on the curve but Exp 129a suggests the direction is harmful (more noise dims = more rank-1 pressure). The mechanism is understood: wider noise amplifies shared pathway.

levers.match_count: energy score: ~12 matches; replace CRPS: 4 matches
experiments_found: Post-RC12 Lever I (ES as primary loss — replace CRPS entirely)
levers.key_finding: Exp 99k tested CRPS + full Energy Score (ES as AUXILIARY loss, not primary). Result: decorrelation improved (corr 0.92→0.61) but exposed uniform ~0.07 std across all cells. No weather system uses ES as primary training loss per literature search. Post-RC12 Lever I proposes replacing CRPS entirely with Energy Score — this has never been tried. Current use (99k) was ES as AUXILIARY alongside CRPS.
levers.verdict: ES as AUXILIARY tried (Exp 99k). ES as PRIMARY LOSS (replacing CRPS entirely) is GENUINELY UNTRIED.
levers.note: The distinction matters: CRPS+ES auxiliary (99k) vs ES-only primary are fundamentally different training regimes. ES-only is genuinely untried.

search_terms: variogram AND (0.5 OR increase OR higher)
lambda_vs AND (0.5 OR higher OR increase)
levers.match_count: lambda_vs=0.5: 2 explicit matches; lambda_vs=1.0: found as 145a
levers.key_finding: Both lambda_vs=0.5 (Exp 93a) and lambda_vs=1.0 (Exp 145a) have been tried and failed. Exp 93a: variogram score value did NOT decrease with higher weight (model architecturally cannot comply), kurtosis collapsed. Exp 145a: labeled 'VALUABLE FAILURE' — KS daily dropped from 22→2. The post-RC12 lever J proposes lambda_vs=0.5 but this is exactly Exp 93a's setting (already falsified).
levers.verdict: TRIED AND FALSIFIED. lambda_vs=0.5 (Exp 93a) and lambda_vs=1.0 (Exp 145a) both failed. The mechanism is understood: model cannot reduce VS loss architecturally, so it collapses kurtosis instead.
levers.note: Lever J (lambda_vs 0.1→0.5) is NOT genuinely untried — it is Exp 93a exactly. Post-RC12 table appears to have missed this when listing it as an untried lever.

levers.match_count: learned rho: ~10 matches; horizon-adaptive rho: 1 match in post-RC12 table
levers.key_finding: Condition-dependent learned rho tried in Exp 103a: rho converged to 0.29 (CRPS-optimal), not the desired 0.8 for realistic dynamics. Hurt KS badly. 103a_v2 clamped rho to [0.6, 0.95] — still failed because without distributional loss, learned rho cannot help. HOWEVER: these experiments used a SCALAR learned rho (single value per condition). The Post-RC12 Lever C ('horizon-adaptive rho: low at h=1, high at h=30') is a HORIZON-VARYING schedule (not condition-dependent scalar) — this specific form has NOT been tried.
levers.verdict: Scalar learned rho (103a, 103a_v2) TRIED AND FAILED. Horizon-adaptive rho (rho(t) varies by horizon step, not condition) is GENUINELY UNTRIED.
levers.note: 103a used condition-dependent rho (same value across all horizons). Horizon-adaptive rho (lower early horizons, higher late horizons within one trajectory) is architecturally distinct and untried.

levers.match_count: MoE: 1 match (FinCast reference only); multi-decoder: 0 matches; multiple decoder: 0 matches
experiments_found: FinCast reference (MoE mentioned as literature, not implemented)
levers.key_finding: No experiment has tested multiple decoders, mixture of experts, or parallel mini-decoders. FinCast (CIKM 2025) is mentioned as using MoE but only as literature context. Post-RC12 Lever E ('N=5 decoders with independent noise, average output — structurally prevents rank-1') is listed as untried with ~100 LOC effort estimate.
levers.verdict: GENUINELY UNTRIED. No experiment has tested any multi-decoder or MoE architecture.
levers.note: Lever E (multiple mini-decoders) is fully untried. The structural argument (independent noise per decoder prevents rank-1) has never been tested empirically.

levers.match_count: spread_weight: ~15 matches; anneal: 2 matches in post-RC12 context
experiments_found: H1a proposal (spread_weight=0.65, proposed but superseded before execution)
H3 spread weight annealing (0.9→0.5 over 15 epochs, proposed in RC10 but never executed)
levers.key_finding: Fixed spread_weight=0.3 tried in Exp 136a — FALSIFIED (strictly inferior to IS, reduced spread reward across the board). spread_weight=0.65 was H1a in RC9, proposed but user correctly challenged as unprincipled and it was replaced by the mechanistic RC10 compass before execution. Spread weight annealing (high→standard: 0.9→0.5) was proposed as RC10-H3 but was NEVER EXECUTED — it appears in the RC10 compass planning but no experiment ran it.
levers.verdict: Fixed low spread_weight TRIED AND FALSIFIED (Exp 136a). Spread weight ANNEALING (0.9→0.5 schedule) is GENUINELY UNTRIED — it was planned in RC10 but execution never happened.
levers.note: The annealing schedule (high spread_weight early for exploration, lower later for exploitation) is conceptually distinct from fixed asymmetric CRPS. It has not been run.

4_freeze_CLN (Lever G: freeze CLN on 146b+factor-noise, not tried on this arch)

critical_flags: Lever J (increase VS weight 0.1→0.5) listed as 'untried' in post-RC12 table is ACTUALLY Exp 93a exactly — already falsified. The post-RC12 table has an error here.

noise_dim=128 (Lever D) has never been run but the directional evidence from Exp 129a (noise_dim=64 worse) suggests it would be harmful for the same reason — wider noise amplifies shared pathway rank-1 pressure.

Biased CRPS warmup (Lever F) is the highest-priority genuinely untried lever: supported by two production systems (CRPS-LAM, FourCastNet3), zero code change to architecture, targets the TRAINING STAGE bottleneck identified in Post-RC12 analysis.
